title: The Opposition to Nehemiah's Building Work
description: Nehemiah faces strong opposition from Sanballat, Tobiah and other enemies while the wall of Jerusalem is being rebuilt, but the people work with one hand and hold a weapon in the other, trusting that God will fight for them.
